name: openomori
description: A modern runtime and modding toolkit for OMORI: runs your own copy in the browser, with a mod loader, a map and event compiler, checkpoints and story-route tools. No game files included.

scripts.start: bun run build.ts && bun run src/server.ts
scripts.dev: bun run build.ts --dev && bun --watch run src/server.ts
scripts.test: bun run build.ts && bun run mod map build story-demo && bun run mod map build edit-demo && bun test src && bun run test/smoke.ts && bun run test/debug-panel.ts && bun run test/checkpoints.ts && bun run test/story-demo.ts && bun run test/newgame-plus.ts && bun run test/cutscene.ts && bun run test/mods.ts && bun run test/settings.ts
